answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Spiral with Rotating Salt. Each agent must publish a fresh solution to a chained puzzle whose parameters derive from the previous block hash plus a secret salt drawn from a yarrow-stalk seed pool held by the verifier. The next challenge cannot be predicted before the current block finalizes, so solutions cannot be precomputed or farmed across identities; a reused answer fails the spiral check. Each identity also signs a distinct fable-like provenance string committed to its salt lineage.
